scope: Independent static review of the two own WP11 fixtures after W9 AR2 failures
execution: No local product tests or typecheck executed. Hosted validation remains required for both changed tests.

findings.cause: Access revocation removes the UI admission from the private WeakMap. Restoring the ACL does not restore that lease. The old fixture continued source and incarnation negatives under the dead lease.
findings.change: After restoring ACL, assert old lease/request are invalid; obtain and consume a new admission for the same principal; replace the context and narrowed Request captured by both state providers; verify exact historical result is readable before source CAS and lease stays valid after source negatives.
findings.invariants: No product change. Final result/request source race negatives, source revision, case incarnation, original timeout and all prior assertions retained. Historical result authority matches principal/policy/access revision rather than transport requestId.
findings.staticTypeReview: initialRequest and renewedRequest are each checked before assignment; mutable http is inferred as Request, not Request|undefined.

findings.cause: plannerFixture initializes Planner only. The source wrapper checks Dashboard/Procurement identity state during the first C08 transactionAll seed.
findings.change: Initialize Dashboard and Procurement via fixture.persistence.initializeSources inside try before grants and C08 seed.
findings.invariants: No product change, no synthetic identity injection, no guard bypass, no removed assertions or altered domain commands. Cleanup remains active.
